name: Fire Bolt
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fire a small bolt of fire from your fingertips. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to damage your target. The bolt deals 1d3 points of fire damage and does not ignite combustibles.
